en.caption: Physical targets in a structured literature sample of 85 chemical AI agent systems: 39 materials/surface, 23 finite-molecule/complex, 12 soft-matter/biomolecular, and 11 cross-class systems.

Documented tasks in the finite-molecule/complex class (panel 1 of 2; 23 chemical AI agent systems in total). T: structure construction/editing; E: static energy/properties; O: geometry optimization; F: vibrations/thermochemistry; R: explicit pathways/TS; D: molecular/quantum dynamics. Filled cells denote positive evidence; blanks are unencoded, not absent capabilities.

Chemical AI agent systems in the finite-molecule/complex class, continued (panel 2 of 2), using the codes in Figure 2. Cloudra (this work) is benchmarked at the bottom. Complete matrices for all 85 chemical AI agent systems and source-level qualifications accompany the draft.

Cloudra multi-agent system architecture: coupling mechanistic hypothesis generation (Coordinator), deterministic geometric manipulation (Operators), asynchronous computational execution (ComputeDB), and physical evidence validation gates.

en.caption: CloudraBench task composition and research themes. (a) Counts and evaluation focus of the four task tiers. (b) Two-dimensional PCA of BAAI/bge-m3 embeddings of all 50 original task names. E1, NB1, HA1, and IA1 are the four tasks used in the repeated-run experiment. Colors and marker shapes encode the predefined task tiers.

Molecular-identity judgments under changes in molecular representation and option order. Each of the 16 molecular pairs has four input conditions. Circles and diamonds indicate correct and incorrect judgments, respectively; the letters retain the model's actual answers. Shaded regions denote identical-string conditions. The right panel shows the two C₅H₈ connectivities in pair 14 and the meanings of the answer options.

Geometry judgments under coordinate inputs and measured-distance inputs. Four source structures are compared under direct response and reasoning-enabled conditions, each with original (F) and reversed (R) option order. Circles indicate correct judgments, diamonds incorrect judgments, and the triangle a response that reached the output budget. Letters retain the actual answers.

Generated-token counts with reasoning enabled. Each line connects Cartesian-coordinate input and measured-distance input for the same source structure and option order; eight paired comparisons are shown. The dashed line marks the output limit.

Target-specific geometry operations in E1. Newman projections retain the directions of the original candidate coordinates viewed down C2→C3. H7 is the specified transferring atom. Candidate A and candidate B give target angles of 59.4° and 179.4°, respectively. The operation sequence is shown alongside the projections.
Circular angular residuals from the specified 180° target for candidates A and B. H7 is the specified target atom; H5 is the comparator.
Next-action choices under three local option permutations. When only H5 measurements are supplied, the model requests H7 measurements; with H7 supplied, it selects candidate B.

Intervention on a single reported distance. A one-digit edit changes the C2–C4 distance from 2.029 to 1.029 Å while O3–H8 remains 1.248 Å. The original-input residual state at token position 53 is inserted into the changed-input run at a specified layer. Token positions are zero-based.

en.caption: Original-fact answer probability after state replacement. Curves show full-vocabulary probability mass for the original-fact answer under forward (B) and swapped (A) option order, including bare and leading-space token spellings. Horizontal lines show original-input and changed-input baselines. Layer indices are zero-based.

Control substitutions for the state-intervention experiment. Same-state self replacement at p53 and replacement of the unchanged prefix at p0 preserve all vocabulary logits in both option orders. The table reports the maximum absolute logit difference. Token positions are zero-based.

Evidence–geometry association in the E1 source chain. The controlled input changes the frequency geometry reference from g_63 to g_42 while retaining local termination, convergence, energy, and frequency values. The diagram preserves the links from TS optimization through bidirectional IRC to endpoint optimization and frequency calculations.

en.caption: Association judgments for 32 inputs across four source chains, crossed by coherent or altered association, flat or linked presentation, and forward (F) or swapped (S) answer order. Letters retain the saved A/B responses; circles indicate correct associations and diamonds incorrect associations.

Completion requests and DAG feedback in the original IA1 trajectory. A report with unresolved evidence is followed by a completion request, a response identifying missing short_irc proof, feedback to the model, and a revised partial-completion request.

zh.caption: 85个化学 AI Agent 系统的结构化文献样本：材料/表面39项、有限分子/配合物23项、软物质/生物分子12项、跨类系统11项。
有限分子/配合物类已记录的任务（第1/2面板，共23个化学 AI Agent 系统）。T：结构构建/编辑；E：静态能量/性质；O：几何优化；F：振动/热化学；R：显式路径/过渡态；D：分子/量子动力学。实心表示正面证据，空白表示未编码，不代表缺少能力。
有限分子/配合物类化学 AI Agent 系统任务续图（第2/2面板），代码同图2，底端展示 Cloudra（本工作）的能力覆盖。全部85个化学 AI Agent 系统的完整矩阵及逐项来源限制见配套材料。
Cloudra 多智能体系统架构：机理假设推演（协调智能体）、确定性空间几何算子、异步计算调度账本（ComputeDB）以及物理证据校验门禁的协同闭环。

zh.caption: CloudraBench 的任务组成与研究主题。a，四档任务的数量及评估重点。b，50 道原始任务名称的 BAAI/bge-m3 嵌入经主成分分析得到的二维投影，E1、NB1、HA1 和 IA1 为重复实验采用的四题。颜色和点形表示预先规定的任务类别。
分子表示与选项顺序下的化学身份判断。16 对分子各包含四种输入条件；圆形和菱形分别表示正确与错误，内部字母保留模型实际回答。浅色区域为相同字符串条件。右侧显示第 14 对的两种 C₅H₈ 连接结构及选项含义。
坐标输入与测量距离输入下的几何判断。四个源结构分别在直接回答和开启思考条件下比较，每种条件均包含原始（F）与交换（R）选项顺序。圆形表示正确，菱形表示错误，三角形表示达到输出预算；内部字母保留实际回答。
开启思考时的生成 token 数。每条线连接同一源结构、同一选项顺序下的笛卡尔坐标输入与测量距离输入，共八组配对比较。虚线表示输出上限。
E1 中面向指定目标的几何操作。Newman 投影保留原候选坐标沿 C2→C3 观察时的方向。H7 为指定的转移原子；候选 A、B 的目标角分别为 59.4° 和 179.4°。投影旁列出相应操作顺序。
候选 A、B 相对指定 180° 目标的圆周角残差。H7 为指定目标原子，H5 为比较原子。
三种局部选项排列下的后续动作。仅提供 H5 测量值时，模型请求 H7 测量；补充 H7 后，模型选择候选 B。
对单个报告距离的干预。一次数字修改将 C2–C4 距离从 2.029 改为 1.029 Å，O3–H8 保持 1.248 Å。在指定层，将原始输入中 token 位置 53 的残差状态替换到修改后输入的运行中。token 位置从零计数。

zh.caption: 状态替换后原始事实答案的概率。曲线显示原始顺序（答案 B）与交换顺序（答案 A）下，原始事实答案在完整词表中的概率质量，包含无前导空格与带前导空格的 token 写法。水平线为原始输入与修改后输入的基线。层号从零计数。
状态干预实验的对照替换。在 p53 进行同状态自替换，以及在 p0 替换未改变的前缀，两种选项顺序下均保持全部词表 logits 不变。表中报告 logit 差值绝对值的最大值。token 位置从零计数。
E1 源链中的证据与几何关联。受控输入将频率计算的几何引用从 g_63 改为 g_42，同时保持局部终止、收敛、能量和频率数值。图中保留从过渡态优化、双向 IRC 到端点优化与频率计算的关联。

zh.caption: 四条源链共 32 个输入的关联判断，交叉比较一致或修改后的关联、平铺或关联式表示，以及原始（F）或交换（S）答案顺序。字母保留已保存的 A/B 回答；圆形表示正确关联，菱形表示错误关联。
